commands.help: Lists local network connections; output detail and filtering vary by platform.
commands.long_help: On Windows, displays TCP/UDP IPv4/IPv6 connections with state, owning process name, and PID, filtered by the bitmask 0x0001=TCP4, 0x0010=TCP6, 0x0100=UDP4, and 0x1000=UDP6. Linux uses the same bits to select raw /proc/net tables and does not add owning-process names. macOS runs /usr/sbin/netstat -an and reports all socket families regardless of the requested filter, while echoing the filter value. Default 0x1111 (4369) requests all Windows and Linux tables.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: Bitmask selecting which tables to display. Common values: 4369=all (default), 1=TCP4 only, 17=all TCP, 4352=all UDP, 257=IPv4 only, 4112=IPv6 only. Combine individual bits: 1=TCP4, 16=TCP6, 256=UDP4, 4096=UDP6.
